title: Compose a radically different Big Beat sketch
description: Create and audition a new 16-bar Big Beat score that deliberately avoids Fence Signal’s found-object-loop opening, tom-led rhythm family, and section recipe. Use a different hook source and a new drum identity; render and measure it for listener review before any cloud publish.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Cast The Power loop-4 as the hook at 128 BPM in D minor. The 4-bar drum-only dance-punk sketch compiled and measured cleanly. Full 16-bar audition uses drum ignition (1–4), hook drive (5–8), stop-start hook cuts (9–12), and bell/China return (13–16). Current objective_v2: 100.48; steering only suggests a small A#1 notch in the intentionally chromatic warning cut, so it was not applied before listener review.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Listener rejected the sparse vocal-cut middle. Replaced only the 9–12 hook arrangement with the full loop under a 1.8 kHz → 7 kHz low-pass sweep, retaining the stop-start drum pattern. Full vocal revision measured objective_v2 102.47 (up from 100.48) with no v2 guard violations.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Listener found the full vocal loop monotonous. Revised the arrangement: hook now appears only in bars 5–6 (two passes); bars 7–8 switch to a new drum-only kick/snare/bell drive; bars 9–12 retain the drum choke; bars 13–16 are an all-drums bell/China finish. Rendered and measured objective_v2 102.00. This is a listener-directed arrangement choice over the prior full-vocal score (102.47).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Listener clarified that the prior two-pass version did not repeat the source enough. The hook’s natural length is about two bars at 128 BPM, so it is now scheduled explicitly at bars 5, 7, and 9 (three complete passes), then removed at bar 11 for the drum-only choke and finish. Rendered objective_v2 remains 102.00.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Clarified final form: preserve drum-only intro in bars 1–4. Then alternate equal two-bar calls and answers: hook+drums 5–6, drums 7–8, hook+drums 9–10, drums 11–12, hook+drums 13–14, drums 15–16. Rendered objective_v2 102.00.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Published the approved Circuit Breaker call-and-response score. Production preflight initially found The Power loop-4 annotation missing; synchronized only ccmixter/Citizen-X0/The-Power_31546.mp3 via sample import (56 created, 9 updated, 0 skipped), then created scr_scores_Circuit Breaker_apr. Fetched record text exactly matches the approved local score.
